content: Within three months, Sabrina will demonstrate the ability to walk up and down stairs using an alternating foot pattern with hand support in 4 out of 5 opportunities, enhancing gross motor coordination and balance.
Within four months, Sabrina will independently don a pullover shirt in 4 out of 5 attempts, demonstrating improved self-care skills and motor planning.

Within five months, Sabrina will engage in a structured play activity with a peer for at least 5 minutes, with no more than 1 verbal prompt, supporting social participation and cooperative play skills.
Within four months, Sabrina will correctly identify and match primary colors in 4 out of 5 opportunities, improving visual-motor integration and cognitive processing.
Within three months, Sabrina will exhibit increased tactile processing by tolerating various consistencies and textures during a meal in 4 out of 5 meals, with minimal verbal reassurance.
Within six months, Sabrina will use a spoon to scoop and bring food to her mouth with minimal assistance in 4 out of 5 meal times, demonstrating enhanced adaptive skills and fine motor control.

Within five months, Sabrina will complete a familiar three-step obstacle course independently with no more than 2 verbal prompts in 4 out of 5 attempts, improving bilateral coordination and motor planning.
Within three months, Sabrina will participate in a 10-minute sensory-rich activity with no more than 2 signs of overstimulation, supporting sensory processing and self-regulation.
